cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Don’t Question the Premise
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to ask why the strange situation exists toward what must happen next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Hold this bucket under the seascape. I'll get towels before the gallery floor floods.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why is a painting leaking? I said we should buy a print.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. You can choose the replacement. Tilt the bucket toward the waves.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why are there fish? This bucket's nearly full.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fetch the aquarium from reception. I'll hold this one until you're back.

mechanism: A supervises containment of a leaking seascape, treating each why question as a prompt for the next preservation task.
confusable: D150 searches for a rule; D158 refuses causal inquiry and directs immediate action without claiming the explanation.
comparison: Art emergency and limited containers differ from getting a ghost breakfast during a commute.
seedUse: Keep bucket angle and fish/fullness, using existing practical options rather than an unexplained aquarium rescue.
